672e2e7500543603d91e0101.name: Nomad Reflex Sight

The FAST Optic Riser provides an elevated M1913 Picatinny platform for direct attachment of optics, such as EOTech® EXPS, Vortex UH-1 and other lower 1/3 co-witness optics.

672e2e7503876d1630af50b0.name: Devil MLOK grip

672e2e7504b1f1d5b0e4209c.name: Scott FM3 protective mask
672e2e7504b1f1d5b0e4209c.description: Approved to EN 136 Class 3, the highest standard for safety.

672e2e7505c0ffbaf790db95.name: SureFire flashlight with pressure pad
672e2e7505c0ffbaf790db95.description: WMLx White - Gen 2 sets the standard for balancing output, reliability, and value in a compact white-light capability for your rifle or carbine. Extensively proven amidst prolonged rapid firing, rough handling, and harsh conditions, it is a match for adversity in any clime or place.

672e2e75071e71f8e4a59286.name: Wilcox tactical device
672e2e75071e71f8e4a59286.description: Compact laser and flashlight device for mounting on picatinny rails.

672e2e750c562a5e650dc9b3.name: Scalarworks LEAP/Scope mount
672e2e750c562a5e650dc9b3.description: Designed for shooters who want the lightest, strongest, and most compact quick-detach red dot sight mount possible. The LEAP/01 redefines the standard for mounting your Aimpoint Micro T-2 footprint compatible optic to your AR-15 Picatinny top rail.

672e2e750cd8dfd1fee34a08.name: AR-15 ZipLine stock
672e2e750cd8dfd1fee34a08.description: Legendary blueprint from a specific game. Fits AR-15 and compatible weapons.

672e2e750ea81b3b93b943ac.name: TGC combat belt (Black)

The belt is equipped with a quick-release buckle and a system of additional pouches for carrying equipment. The belt is made of durable materials and is designed for long-term use in harsh conditions.

672e2e7511180730151307bc.name: KAC Rail Cover

672e2e755cebe435a3b4dba5.name: Daniel Defense 5.56 magazine
672e2e755cebe435a3b4dba5.description: The DD Magazine is the only AR-15 magazine worthy of the Daniel Defense name and is built with the same quality and standards as their world-class firearms. Its 32-round capacity for 5.56mm and 300 Blackout rounds is the most notable enhancement while maintaining the same size as industry-standard 30-round magazines.

The front sight post can be removed so that the rear BUIS aperture can be used with a traditional front sight such as our FUSION fixed or folding sights  (if present), creating a more conventional sight radius. However, the built in front/rear BUIS is perfect for backup on super short PDW/SMG platforms where rail space is critical for mounting lights and lasers.

672e2e75aedb36663267e181.name: Classic US Helmet
